basic_info.description: Large 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers a perfect blend of modern upgrades and spacious living. This home boasts a huge den with sloped ceilings that reach up to an impressive 20 feet, creating an airy and open ambiance providing ample space for various purposes, whether it's a home office, entertainment room, or a cozy retreat to unwind in. The bathrooms have been tastefully remodeled, with modern fixtures and finishes. The kitchen has brand new appliances, new granite countertops and there is brand new flooring throughout the home. An automatic remote controlled garage door was installed and in the backyard, there is ample space for anyone to add their personal touch.
